purpose: Allow autonomous causal work inside an already-authorized A1 envelope without requalifying the controller after every valid commit.

invariants.qualification_transport: CQ remains single-shot, preflight-head-bound and CQ_JOURNAL_ONLY.
invariants.operational_transport: A1 operational commits use a separate external checkpoint chained from the qualified control head.
invariants.authority: No operational checkpoint can expand repo_scope, permissions, A2/A3, promotion, Ready or merge.
invariants.writer: Exactly one write-capable executor per worktree/session.
invariants.git: Normal non-force push only through the protected A1 transport.

recovery.retry_rule: A failed command may be retried only after an identified causal delta, except read-only remote reconciliation.
partial_publish: If local HEAD equals remote HEAD, publication is already complete: advance checkpoint without creating another commit.
If local HEAD is exactly one validated successor of checkpoint and remote remains checkpoint, retry only the push/readback.
If remote advanced to the local validated successor, reconcile as published and advance checkpoint.
Any other divergence is UNKNOWN_EFFECT/BLOCKED and requires human adjudication.
